purpose: BookMe v2 UI image review only; no frontend implementation.
scope: Phases 0 through 4; one owner and one existing tenant; public guest booking remains unauthenticated.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity, professionally art-directed BookMe v2 web application UI review image, sharp flat front-on product screenshot, large landscape canvas with readable text. Calm functional enterprise-quality interface: warm off-white workspace, white surfaces, charcoal typography, restrained deep teal primary actions, fine gray rules, modest 6px corner radii, exceptional alignment, realistic input heights, generous but efficient spacing. Neutral sans-serif typography, clear hierarchy. BookMe wordmark in plain typography. Avoid gradients, glassmorphism, decorative illustrations, giant rounded cards, excessive shadows, emojis, marketing slogans, fake analytics and dashboard metrics. One owner, one existing business called Demo Studio. No teams, roles, invites, services, payments, email notifications, OAuth, forgot-password, booking management, business switching, public slugs or other unplanned features. These are design review mockups, not a marketing landing page. All visible dates are illustrative November 2026. Do not show source code, API paths, JWTs or database terms in product UI. Render UI text accurately and legibly.
Asset 01: Desktop owner dashboard. Render one complete polished desktop screen in a landscape 3:2 composition, no device hardware, no perspective. Narrow top app header BookMe at left, small "Demo Studio" context, at right "View booking page ↗", "owner@example.com" and "Log out". Main centered content width about 1180px. Page heading "Availability", subtitle "Set your weekly hours, then create bookable times." Compact muted status near title "All changes saved".
Main two-column layout, weekly-hours panel ~65% left, generation panel ~35% right. Left: section "Weekly hours"; two settings above table: timezone select "Asia/Kolkata" with label "Business timezone", slot length segmented selection showing "15 min", "30 min" selected, "45 min", "60 min" under label "Slot duration". Small helper "Hours are interpreted in your business timezone." Clean 7-row table with column labels "Day", "Availability", "From", "To". Exactly seven weekday rows Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Monday through Friday have on switches and editable "09:00" and "17:00" time fields. Saturday and Sunday have off switches with "Closed" and disabled time fields. No add-window plus controls. Footer left aligned secondary status, right "Save changes" primary button.
Right panel: heading "Generate slots", helper "Create open times from your saved weekly hours." two date inputs labels "From" and "To" values "23 Nov 2026" and "29 Nov 2026". Helper "Up to 14 days at a time." subdued selected preset "Next 7 days". Primary full-width button "Generate slots". Below thin divider show an inline green success result "80 new slots created" and text "23–29 Nov 2026". Small quiet helper "Existing slots and bookings are kept." Secondary link "View available times ↗".
Tiny neutral footer below main content "Demo Studio · Asia/Kolkata". Fit everything comfortably with correct control proportions and coherent typography. No sidebar with empty navigation. Focus on realistic shippable product design.

Asset 02: Owner authentication design review board. Landscape 3:2 image, two equally sized desktop browser viewport designs side by side, discreet external labels "01 / Sign in" and "02 / Create owner account" above them. The image is a presentation of two alternative app routes, not two forms on the same website page. Each viewport has a small BookMe wordmark top left and quiet link "Back to booking" top right, large plain warm white margins and a centered narrow form, precise input alignment. No split-screen marketing illustration.
Left screen: heading "Welcome back", supporting text "Sign in to manage your availability." Field "Email" filled "owner@example.com"; field "Password" masked dots, accessible eye icon. Solid teal primary button "Sign in". Bottom line "New here? Create owner account" with latter underlined link. Small muted footer "Demo Studio".
Right screen: heading "Create owner account", supporting text "Manage availability for Demo Studio." Fields "Name" filled "Alex Morgan"; "Email" filled "owner@example.com"; "Password" masked dots with helper "At least 8 characters". Solid teal button "Create account". Bottom line "Already have an account? Sign in". Small muted footer "Demo Studio".
Below both viewports, an organized compact design-review component strip separated from the screens by ample space and a hairline, heading "Authentication feedback". Three small accurately typed inline notice examples with restrained colors:
"Invalid email or password"
"An owner account already exists. Sign in instead."
"Your session has ended. Please sign in again."
These are labeled alternate feedback examples, not simultaneous errors on the main forms. Include one quiet in-progress button example "Signing in…" and a small text example "Restoring your session…" to cover session restoration without describing tokens or technical mechanisms. No remember-me checkbox, no terms checkbox, no OAuth, no email verification, no password reset, no extra features. Render all text crisply. Match the dashboard's deep teal, white, gray and typography.

Asset 03: Public guest booking flow review board. Landscape 3:2 canvas, three clean equal-size front-on web viewport panels horizontally arranged with discreet external labels "01 / Choose a time", "02 / Your details", "03 / Confirmed". Consistent public app view throughout, substantial legible typography. Each panel has small BookMe wordmark header, main heading "Demo Studio", subtitle "Book a time". Public flow has no login wall, account creation or required sign-in. Do not redesign as a calendar date-picker or service catalogue; preserve simple open-time list → name/email form → inline confirmation flow. Very subtle borders between panels.
First panel: intro "Choose an open time." small timezone label "Times shown in Asia/Kolkata". Section "Open times". Day group "Tuesday, 24 November", rows "09:00–09:30", "09:30–10:00", "10:00–10:30", each with a modest outlined "Book" action. Day group "Wednesday, 25 November", rows "09:00–09:30", "09:30–10:00" with "Book". Only available slots visible, no disabled booked slots. Neutral small footer "No account needed".
Second panel: heading "Your details". Selected time summary with thin teal left rule, "Tuesday, 24 November" and "09:30–10:00 · Asia/Kolkata". Label "Name", input "Jamie Chen"; label "Email", input "jamie@example.com". Teal primary "Confirm booking", understated text link "Back to open times". Helper "Your name and email are used for this booking." No phone, notes, payment or services fields.
Third panel: calm confirmation state with small check icon and heading "You're booked". Summary "Jamie Chen", "Tuesday, 24 November", "09:30–10:00 · Asia/Kolkata", "jamie@example.com". Supporting text "Your booking is confirmed." Small "Open times" section with two remaining available times beneath, excluding the booked slot. Do not promise email was sent, no email delivery, no add-to-calendar, cancellation/reschedule or booking-management actions.
Bottom of board, distinctly outside the three screens, use a compact full-width strip labeled "Alternate guest states" with four small examples: amber "That time was just booked. Choose another open time."; neutral "No open times right now."; red "Could not load available times." with "Try again"; small validation example "Enter a valid email address." Use restrained single-line status designs, readable and tidy, not decorative. This is one coherent realistic product flow.

Asset 04: Responsive mobile designs and dashboard feedback review board, landscape 3:2 image. Three vertical narrow mobile web viewports side by side, accurate responsive web UI at approximately 390 logical pixels wide, modest thin borders, no fake phone hardware or perspective. Match the other BookMe concepts exactly: warm white, plain bold BookMe wordmark, charcoal sans-serif, thin neutral dividers, restrained deep teal. Large enough touch targets. Viewport 1: compact BookMe header and "Log out" text action, small "owner@example.com" below. Heading "Availability". Business timezone labeled select "Asia/Kolkata". Label "Slot duration" and four compact options "15", "30" selected, "45", "60" with helper "minutes". Section "Weekly hours". Seven compact rows "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun". Viewport 2: same owner header. Treat this as a scrolled lower section of the same dashboard, not a new route. Heading "Generate slots", helper "From your saved weekly hours."
